title: v2 envelope
description: What every board hands the v2 door: the contract of core/v2_envelope.py. A board's own schema is the same shape with its board key and its payload pinned.

schema_version.description: the envelope's own version, not the store's _SCHEMA_VERSION

board.description: the dashboard's module key for this board

run_id.description: the dashboard job that wrote it (rawstore.writer_run_id)

data_asof.description: the data's own as-of word, from the board

built_at.description: when this file was written, UTC ISO

private.description: true: never to the AI chat, a mock, a fixture or a log

layout.description: the generic renderers' description: what a board asks to be drawn, never how. Its shape is v2/web/src/board/envelope.ts (step 8, #1316) — a Layout of panels, each with a table, tile, chart or judgement body. It stays type object|null here because v2/tests/test_v2_schemas.py pins this file to one schema per board plus this one, so the layout contract is not a schema file of its own. null means a board the generic renderers do not draw yet.

data.description: the board's payload, exactly as /view/<board>/payload.json serves it
